name: osama-portfolio
description: Bilingual (AR/EN) static portfolio served from GitHub Pages

scripts.build:css: node scripts/build-vendor.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/tailwind.css -o assets/css/tailwind.css --minify
scripts.watch:css: node scripts/build-vendor.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/tailwind.css -o assets/css/tailwind.css --watch
scripts.build:site: node scripts/fetch-github.mjs && node scripts/check-status.mjs && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs _site
